text:
Situation: Paclitaxel 6 mg/mL 50 mL vials are low at Corvale East (6 days) and Corvale Lakeside (9.2 days). Corvale General holds 26.1 days. FDA records show paclitaxel is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; a prior shortage first posted 2021-10-05 is now resolved.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list paclitaxel today. The last posting was 2021-10-05 and is marked resolved. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited holds a VAI inspection classification dated 2024-03-08.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Internal maldistribution drives the risk at East and Lakeside. Corvale General can support transfers while retaining two weeks of supply. Abraxis BioScience, LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today and is a viable purchase source.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 29 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises East to 14 days, leaves General at 17 days. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 4 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — raises Lakeside to 14 days, leaves General at 25 days. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Purchase from Abraxis BioScience, LLC — not on FDA shortage list. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: Purchases from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. or American Regent, Inc. — labels name no identifiable plant for our supply chain verification.
